summary: Natuzzi S.p.A., the Italian furniture maker whose ADSs trade on the NYSE since 1993, filed a 6-K disclosing that on August 26, 2026 the NYSE staff determined to commence delisting proceedings under Section 802.01B because the company's 30-trading-day average global market capitalization fell below US$15 million. On September 10, 2026 Natuzzi requested a review by a Committee of the NYSE Board under Section 804.00; the hearing is scheduled for the first review day, at least 25 business days after filing. Separately, controlling shareholder Invest 2003 S.r.l. irrevocably agreed on September 9, 2026 to reclassify an additional €5,000,000 of shareholder loans as a versamento in conto futuro aumento di capitale, expected to be booked as an equity reserve at September 30, 2026. Watch the review outcome and whether further equity conversion cures the listing deficiency, plus any appeal-driven overhang in thinly traded ADSs.
